quests.title: Climb one step
quests.ask: Write `step_up()`: facing a step, the robot ends on top of it, facing east.
quests.nudge: Walk it with your finger: up first, or along first?

quests.title: Down one step
quests.ask: Write `step_down()`: the robot has just stepped off a step's edge, with the next step right under it. It goes down onto that step and ends facing east.
quests.nudge: Where is the robot when it needs this, and where does the next step begin?

quests.title: Stairs of another height
quests.ask: A shorter staircase, with no walk to the foot. Climb it, go down the other side to the far wall, and pick every gem.
quests.nudge: How can the robot tell it has reached the top?

quests.title: Across a wide top
quests.ask: This staircase has a flat top two cells wide. Cross it and come down to the far wall, picking every gem.
quests.nudge: Not every step forward on the way down is a step down. How can the robot tell?
